propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos annua sanctorum Martyrum tuorum Cyriaci, Largi et Smaragdi
solemnitate laetificas: concede propitius; ut, quorum natalicia colimus,
virtutem quoque passionis imitemur. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:

Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

supplicatione salutaris, pro quorum solemnitate defertur. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

cujus exsequimur cultum, intercedentibus sanctis Martyribus tuis Cyriaco,
Largo et Smaragdo, sentiamus effectum. Per Dominum.
